title: Black Petal
chapter_title: A Voice That Knows Your Name
premise: Ilyra follows her missing brother’s voice into a condemned glasshouse. Its beautiful predator repeats stolen speech; breaking the rooted bloom frees a trapped caretaker but destroys the comforting illusion she came for.
emotional_engine: Hunger for reunion versus the courage to demand evidence. Ilyra can fight decisively yet remains vulnerable to one familiar sentence.
future_engine: A trade in cultivated memories leads through haunted estates and impossible gardens. Each case offers a seductive version of a missing person, while Ilyra seeks what actually happened to her brother.

style_contract.medium: Elegant softly modeled pale faces, fine controlled hair edges, desaturated portrait illustration, translucent broad charcoal petals with selective silver filigree.
style_contract.retain: Intimate beautiful unease and scale contrast between tailored human and floral horror.
style_contract.avoid: Anime conversion, armor clutter, all-over silver threads, dense moss grain, gore and generic haunted-house rubble.

cast.name: Ilyra Sen
cast.visual: Pale adult woman, elegant oval face, gray eyes, smooth chin-length dark brown bob with ivory nape underlayer. Black split-tail coat, high white collar, dark pleated combat trousers, slim boots.
cast.equipment: One silver single-edge saber with open oval black guard in RIGHT hand; silver LEFT forearm guard. Small plain silver clasp at collar.

cast.name: Neris
cast.visual: Light-skinned older female caretaker, long angular nose, gray hair in low knot, plain charcoal dress, faded ivory shawl. Wary and practical.
cast.equipment: Plain iron door key on waist cord; no weapon.

cast.name: Mourning Bloom
cast.visual: Enormous translucent charcoal flower, empty oval center edged with sparse silver thorns, broad dark petals, ONE thick tapering root ending in a single thorn foot. No humanoid mask or hands.
cast.equipment: Heavy petals sweep like broad cutting leaves; root pins a door threshold.

setting: Abandoned curved-rib glasshouse in pale overcast mist. White entrance at LEFT, small caretaker room with a weight-jammed door at RIGHT; broad matte maroon ground, a few pale fallen petals.
power_rule: The bloom can replay stolen voices only while its single thick root is planted; it must lift that root to turn its heavy face. Root exposed during a committed petal sweep. Ilyra has ordinary saber skill, no new aura.
